title: Counterexamples to the restricted-sumset inverse theorem in arXiv:2609.10148v2
summary: Explicit finite counterexamples to Theorem A (Theorem 3.1) and Lemma 3.2 of Li and Liang, arXiv:2609.10148v2. In Z/13Z, sets of sizes seven and four satisfy all size hypotheses and have restricted sumset size nine, but neither is an arithmetic progression. A separate example in Z/11Z contradicts the lower bound of Lemma 3.2 as stated.

review.reason: Explicit finite counterexamples to a restricted-sumset inverse theorem in a preprint.
